column1: # Bottom layer for tests/cxraw.cx and tests/cxlibc.cx (the libc/POSIX call counts): path
# L0 modules are no longer listed: a module exempts itself with `#pragma unisa dock`.
# prefixes (ending in /) or exact paths listed here are not counted.  tests/cxinclude.cx
# (#include) reads tests/cxinclude-boundary.tsv instead, not this file.
# The product layer is a directory boundary: cx/sys/ cx/mem/ cx/text/ are L0; every other
# product file (src/, cx/) reaches libc only through them.  Tool and test scripts (tools/,
# tests/) run on this host only, are not product cx modules, and may print with printf/fprintf,
# so they are not counted here.  (cx upper modules that live under tools/ -- e.g. cxcc.cx --
# will declare their host docking explicitly once plans/cx-dock-pragma.md lands; this file is
# the interim boundary.)
# ext/sysx/ (including net/reaper/trace) is optional, outside product L0; its docking
# code keeps the existing call-count accounting. Moving a module here must
# not add or remove counted calls; new files and new lines are still debt.
# ext/memx/ and ext/textx/ are L0-equivalent too: they hold the arena and
# num/build/deflate libraries (grow/slice/fmt moved into cx/mem and cx/text, CXS-C3 S2;
# product links none of them). Moving a module here must
# not add or remove counted calls: arena docks calloc/free, text.num strtol/strtoul/strtod,
# text.fmt vsnprintf, and all of that already sits under the cx/mem/ and cx/text/ rows below.
tools/
tests/
# cx0 projection fragments (T8): host-zone C blocks from which src/cxmod.c is assembled; same bootstrap layer as src/host.cx.
cx/cx0/proj/
# host bootstrap: the files that start a product build before any module exists.
src/host.cx
src/hostnative.cx
# src/hostout.cx: the hs_out_* split out of src/host.cx (SIZE-01 room-making).
# Same bootstrap layer, same lifetime, same reason: it runs before any module
# exists, so it reaches libc directly like its source file.
src/hostout.cx
# src/hostres.cx: the hs_file split out of src/host.cx (SIZE-01 room-making).
# Same bootstrap layer, same lifetime, same reason.
src/hostres.cx
# header-surface probes: they exist to exercise a carried header, so migrating them to sys.*
# would delete the test (reasons in tests/cxinclude-boundary.tsv).
apps/csih/probes/netwit.cx
apps/csih/probes/tmuxwit.cx
apps/csih/probes/retry_stub.cx
apps/csih/tests/tclock.cx
